def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    intercept = 0.0477
    underwriter_rank = 6
    pre_offer_price_adjustment = 0.04
    offer_size = 40
    fraction_retained = 0.70

    underwriter_rank_coefficient = 0.0150
    pre_offer_price_adjustment_coefficient = 0.4350
    offer_size_coefficient = -0.0009
    fraction_retained_coefficient = 0.0500

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    initial_return = (
        intercept
        + underwriter_rank_coefficient * underwriter_rank
        + pre_offer_price_adjustment_coefficient * pre_offer_price_adjustment
        + offer_size_coefficient * offer_size
        + fraction_retained_coefficient * fraction_retained
    )

    # Return the anticipated initial return rounded to three decimal places
    answer = round(initial_return, 3)
    return answer
